# Clearpoint Template Tasks & Design Notes

Recreates ColorLib Schmidt (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/schmidt/`).

## Section Structure & Order

1. Navbar (Brand logo, nav links)
2. Hero (Subheading, heading, CTA buttons, hero image)
3. About (Bio, experience count, skills)
4. Services (Grid of services with icons)
5. Experiences (Timeline of work history)
6. Works / Portfolio (Grid of projects)
7. Blog (Recent articles)
8. Contact (Contact form + details)
9. Footer (Copyright + Component Dock link)

## Design Notes

- Color palette: Deep dark/neutral backgrounds with `#d5c455` gold primary accent.
- Typography: Clean modern sans-serif (Poppins).
- Interactive elements: Lucide icons, smooth tab switches, modal previews for portfolio items.
